statement: Under the preconditions, the function returns a result r (it does not fail) and r is the number of triples (a,b,k) such that k >= 1, 0 <= a < m, 0 <= b < n, a+k <= m, b+k <= n, and matrix[i][j] = 1 for every i,j with a <= i < a+k and b <= j < b+k. Equivalently, r = sum over k from 1 to min(m,n) of sum over a from 0 to m-k of sum over b from 0 to n-k of c(a,b,k), where c(a,b,k) is 1 exactly when the contiguous k by k block with top-left (a,b) is all ones and is 0 otherwise. Square submatrices have side length at least 1 and are contiguous in both rows and columns.
